ideas.title: The Web of Deceit: Uncovering Minnesota's Medicaid Fraud Network
ideas.description: Investigate the connections between Minnesota Medicaid fraud cases, including Feeding Our Future and other alleged schemes.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and identify key players
questions: How did the alleged schemes work?
What is the total amount of alleged fraud?
ideas.insight: This story could reveal a larger pattern of fraud and potentially lead to more investigations and convictions.
